name: Hide My Website – Password Protect, Block AI & Hide Admin Login
author: Pranav MT

sections.description:
Hide My Website is a powerful security plugin that allows you to protect your entire WordPress site or specific pages behind a password prompt. It offers various security features to enhance your website’s protection against unauthorized access.

Live Demo

Key Features:
* 🔐 Password protect the entire site or specific pages
* 🧩 Multiple login templates
* 🤖 Block bots by modifying robots.txt
* 🚫 Search engine blocking
* 🧾 IP whitelisting
* 📡 Prevent feeds & XML-RPC
* 📄 Restrict specific pages
* 🗂️ Robots.txt customization
* ✉️ Disable all outgoing emails with one toggle
* 🛑 Admin Bar badge: “Emails disabled”
* 🔗 Hide Admin Login with a custom login URL
* 🤖 Block AI Crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot) with robots.txt rules and HTTP headers (new)

Coming soon:
* 🛡️ Brute-force Protection & Spam IP Block
* ⏱️ Timed access control
* 👥 User role-based access
* 🎨 Customizable login page
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hide-my-website folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘Hide My Website’ settings page to configure the plugin or find the settings link below plugin name in the plugins page.
sections.faq:
Can I protect only certain pages of my website?

Yes, you can choose to protect your entire website or select specific pages to hide behind the password prompt.

Is it possible to allow access to certain IP addresses without requiring a password?

The plugin includes an IP whitelisting feature that allows you to specify IP addresses that can access the site without entering a password.

Is there any option to choose multiple login templates

Yes, the plugin provides multiple login templates
